about.title: Who I am, where I came from and where I’m going.
about.whoText: I’m Clara Cayres, a software engineering student, currently building my path as a front-end developer with full-stack foundations. I’m based between Brazil and the U.S. and I like turning ideas into polished web experiences.
about.originText: I’m from Brazil and my journey mixes technology, international experience, client projects and constant learning.
about.objectiveText: My goal is to grow into a strong front-end or full-stack developer, working on products that combine usability, performance and beautiful interfaces.
about.freetimeText: In my free time, I enjoy doing arts and crafts, building LEGO, watching some of my favorite shows, keeping up with the news, and learning a bit about economics. I also like listening to music and practicing coding.

softSkills: Strong organization and consistency in task execution
timeline: Started career as an Administrative & Operations Intern, gaining hands-on experience with data, processes, and client support
Transitioned into tech while pursuing a Software Engineering degree
Built real-world experience as a Front-End freelancer working on responsive and modern web applications
Expanded into back-end development with IBM Professional Certificate (APIs, databases, microservices)
Specialized in modern front-end development through Meta Certification (React, UI/UX, performance optimization)
Lived an international experience in the United States as an Au Pair, strengthening communication, adaptability, and problem-solving skills
Currently focused on building full-stack applications integrating React, Flask, APIs, and AI-driven features
